item.title: Taylor Farms Called White House to Try to Delay Cyclospora Recall
Hannah Fry Wins the Leelavati Prize in 2026 for Mathematics Outreach
item.description:
📝 Hannah Fry is Professor of the Public Understanding of Mathematics in the Department of Applied Mathematics and Theoretical Physics (DAMTP). Few people have contributed more to this goal than Hannah Fry," says Professor Nick Dorey, Head of the Department of Applied Mathematics and Theoretical Physics. Mathematics is "a completely original way to see the world," says Hannah Fry.
🔗 Read more: https://www.maths.cam.ac.uk/features/professor-hannah-fry-wins-leelavati-prize
